title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Michael Mayer catches three passes in Week 7
items.desc: Michael Mayer caught all three of his targets for 32 yards in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Rams in Week 7.
items.impact: Mayer has seen inconsistent involvement in the Las Vegas passing attack of late, receiving three targets or less in three of his last five contests. The tight end remains difficult to trust in all formats as long as Brock Bowers remains healthy, with a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets up next.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Packers D/ST forces two turnovers Sunday
items.desc: The Packers' D/ST logged two fumble recoveries and one sack while allowing 20 points in Sunday's loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Green Bay's defense played pretty well on Sunday. They slowed down Detroit's elite offense and limited them to just 20 points on the day, and they were also able to log some big plays to help out their own offense. This unit has a short week coming up, with a matchup against the Panthers happening on Thursday night football in Week 8.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Smack misses two kicks in loss Sunday
items.desc: Trey Smack went 1-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The rookie ended up with two missed field-goal attempts on Sunday, which was especially consequential with Green Bay losing by just three points. One of those were blocked, however, which can't really be blamed on him. Still, this wasn't a good performance from him and he will likely be a shaky fantasy option at the position for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd quiet in loss Sunday
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd rushed the ball six times for 20 yards and caught two passes for 15 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Lloyd was still somewhat involved on Sunday and saw eight opportunities, but he wasn't able to do much with them and was entirely outshined by Josh Jacobs in his first game back. There doesn't seem to be much optimism surrounding Lloyd's role or fantasy outlook for the foreseeable future with Jacobs now back in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tucker Kraft finds end zone Sunday
items.desc: Tucker Kraft hauled in 4-of-6 targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Kraft had a solid game on Sunday. He was able to haul in four passes for 49 yards on the afternoon, one of which he was able to get into the end zone on as well. He should continue to be viewed as a weekly starter at the tight end position moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Jacobs scores once in return game Sunday
items.desc: Josh Jacobs rushed the ball 11 times for 36 yards and caught 5-of-7 targets for 55 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Sunday was the first game back for Jacobs after he missed the start of the season while on the Commissioner's Exempt List. He wasn't effective on the ground in his first game back, but he made his hay through the air with five catches, 55 yards, and a touchdown on the day. He should be a viable RB2 over the course of the back half of the season as he continues to knock the rust off after so much time off.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Matthew Golden underwhelming in loss Sunday
items.desc: Matthew Golden caught 6-of-12 targets for 39 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Golden was the most-targeted receiver for Green Bay on Sunday. He wasn't able to make the most out of those opportunities, however, catching just half of his targets and turning that into 39 scoreless yards against Detroit. This was a bit of a down game for him, but he should bounce back in the near future, especially if he continues to be targeted at this rate.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Watson leads team in receiving Sunday
items.desc: Christian Watson caught 5-of-8 targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Watson played a decent game on Sunday. He was able to lead the team with 57 receiving yards on the day, but he didn't get into the end zone at all and only caught five passes, which left him with a mediocre fantasy finish. He will continue to be a must-start option on a week-to-week basis for as long as he continues to be productive.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jordan Love throws two touchdowns in loss Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Love completed 27-of-45 passing attempts for 274 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Love had an okay game on Sunday. He threw for close to 300 yards and two touchdowns over the course of the game, but he also threw two interceptions and didn't have a very high completion percentage on the day. He will continue to be a viable week-to-week streaming option moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lions D/ST allows 17 points in win Sunday
items.desc: The Lions' D/ST logged one sack and one interception while allowing 17 points in Sunday's win over the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Detroit's defense has struggled heavily over the first half of the season, but they looked a lot better on Sunday. They allowed Green Bay's high-powered offense to score just 17 points on the day, which helped Detroit to pick up a key win over their divisional rival. Still, this unit shouldn't be started outside of favorable matchups moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jake Bates scores eight points in win Sunday
items.desc: Jake Bates went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Bates did his job on Sunday, making all four of his attempted kicks in a win over the Packers. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the kicker position moving forward, considering how effective Detroit is at moving the ball.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Isaac TeSlaa quiet in win Sunday
items.desc: Isaac TeSlaa caught 1-of-2 targets for just ten yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: TeSlaa wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He was targeted just twice and ended with just one catch for ten yards in this win over the Packers. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sam LaPorta disappoints in win Sunday
items.desc: Sam LaPorta caught 1-of-2 targets for just 18 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: LaPorta had a disappointing performance on Sunday. He was only able to catch one pass over the course of the entire game, and he was only able to rack up 18 scoreless yards on it, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He should bounce back in the near future, though he will remain prone to bad showings in the future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jameson Williams scores two touchdowns in win Sunday
items.desc: Jameson Williams caught 5-of-9 targets for 91 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: The Lions gave Williams plenty of opportunities on Sunday, and he was able to capitalize on them. He caught two touchdowns and came close to hitting the 100 receiving yards mark, which left him with a terrific fantasy total. He should continue to be viewed as a high-ceiling fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward, though his floor leaves something to be desired.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown leads team in receiving Sunday
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in 9-of-11 targets for 153 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: The veteran wideout played very well on Sunday. He led the team with 153 receiving yards over the course of the afternoon, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone to put the cherry on top. Fantasy managers should continue to regard him as a top-tier option moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jared Goff plays well in win Sunday
items.desc: Jared Goff completed 22-of-32 passing attempts for 303 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: The veteran quarterback played pretty well on Sunday, racking up over 300 yards and scoring twice while leading the Lions to a win over their divisional rival. His lost fumble was less than ideal, but fantasy managers should still be well pleased with his performance in this game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs racks up 143 yards in win Sunday
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed the ball 29 times for 116 yards and caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
items.impact: Gibbs looked good on Sunday. He was a bit more inefficient than usual and failed to get into the end zone at all, but he still racked up 143 total yards on the day and ended with a great fantasy total. He is the best running back in fantasy right now and should continue to produce like it moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Texans D/ST struggles Sunday
items.desc: The Texans D/ST allowed 27 points on 420 total yards with three sacks on Sunday.
items.impact: The Texans defense is not a must roster heading into their bye week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ka'imi Fairbairn makes both field goals Sunday
items.desc: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Fairbairn made field goals from 58 and 57 yards out. He remains a reliable kicker for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dalton Schultz hauls in five passes Sunday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz caught 5-of-6 targets for 45 yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
items.impact: Schultz was the safety blanket for C.J. Stroud on the day. He remains a borderline low-end TE1/high-end TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylin Noel dealing with turf toe
items.desc: Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said Jaylin Noel has a turf toe injury.
items.impact: Noel is likely to miss some time. He is off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Hutchinson hauls in touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards and a touchdown in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
items.impact: Hutchinson hauled in one of the two touchdowns thrown by C.J. Stroud on the day. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tank Dell hauls in big catch Sunday
items.desc: Tank Dell caught his lone target for 43 yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
items.impact: Dell was making his much anticipated return for the first time in two years. He remains off the fantasy radar for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 1-of-4 targets for six yards and a touchdown in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
items.impact: For fantasy managers desperate enough to start Harrison, fortunately his lone catch was in the end zone. He remains in the WR4/WR5 range.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins shut down Sunday
items.desc: Nico Collins caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
items.impact: Collins was completely held in check. He'll look to bounce back off the bye week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Woody Marks totals 20 touches Sunday
items.desc: Woody Marks ran for 66 yards on 19 carries in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants. He also caught his lone target for 15 yards receiving.
items.impact: Marks was the clear workhorse on Sunday. He was unable to break off any big plays or find the end zone. The Texans will hope to get David Montgomery back following their bye week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: C.J. Stroud tosses two touchdowns Sunday
items.desc: C.J. Stroud completed 17-of-28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
items.impact: Stroud did not throw for many yards, but he also didn't commit any turnovers. The Texans are heading into their bye next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Giants D/ST holds their own Sunday
items.desc: The Giants D/ST allowed 21 points on 237 total yards with one sack on Sunday against the Texans.
items.impact: The Giants were unable to force any turnovers. They remain off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dominic Zvada misses two field goals Sunday
items.desc: Dominic Zvada missed both of his field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Zvada had misses from 56 and 44 yards out. He remains off the fantasy radar for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Likely quiet Sunday
items.desc: Isaiah Likely caught 2-of-4 targets for 12 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Giants.
items.impact: Likely was not involved much in the first career start for J.J. McCarthy. He still remains a TE1 heading into the Giants bye week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malachi Fields totals 83 yards Sunday
items.desc: Malachi Fields caught 4-of-5 targets for 83 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Fields recorded a career-best in yardage in the first start with the Giants for J.J. McCarthy. He remains off the fantasy radar for now heading into the Giants bye week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Nabers totals 111 yards Sunday
items.desc: Malik Nabers caught 7-of-9 targets for 111 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Despite the quarterback change, Nabers production remained just as dominant. He remains a WR1 moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devin Singletary scores winning touchdown Sunday
items.desc: Devin Singletary ran for 41 yards and a touchdown on five carries in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Singletary won the game on a 30-yard in overtime. The Giants are on bye next week, but it is worth noting that Cam Skattebo and Tyrone Tracy both got banged up in this game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo records strong performance Sunday
items.desc: Cam Skattebo ran for 124 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Skattebo appeared to injure his hamstring late in the win. He impressed in his first game back since being benched last week. He'll need to be monitored in practice this upcoming week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: J.J. McCarthy impresses through air Sunday
items.desc: J.J. McCarthy completed 20-of-28 passes for 252 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
items.impact: Making his first start for the Giants, McCarthy did not throw a touchdown or turn the ball over. He was able to find Malik Nabers early and often. He'll be a QB2 in superflex and 2-QB leagues moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Vikings D/ST continues to dominate Sunday
items.desc: The Vikings defense allowed 10 points on 218 total yards with four sacks and one interception.
items.impact: Outside of an early Jonathan Taylor touchdown, Minnesota remained shut down defensively all afternoon. The Vikings will draw the Lions next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Reichard makes three field goals Sunday
items.desc: Will Reichard made 3-of-4 field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Reichard connected on field goals from 28, 47 and 52 yards out. He missed from 59 yards on an attempt that was blocked. He remains a fairly safe kicker for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: T.J. Hockenson catches touchdown Sunday
items.desc: T.J. Hockenson caught 4-of-5 targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Hockenson hauled in a short touchdown from Kyler Murray. He'll be a low-end TE1 next week against the Lions.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Addison quiet Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Addison caught 2-of-3 targets for 20 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
items.impact: It was a low volume day for the entire Vikings passing attack. Addison remains a volatile WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jauan Jennings totals 34 yards Sunday
items.desc: Jauan Jennings caught 2-of-3 targets for 34 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Jennings nearly caught a long touchdown from Kyler Murray in the second quarter. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Justin Jefferson quiet Sunday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson caught 4-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
items.impact: It was a quiet afternoon for the entire Vikings passing attack. Jefferson will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Lions.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. suffers knee injury late Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. ran for 26 yards on eight carries in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Jones left in the fourth quarter with a knee injury. He got the start, but Jordan Mason wound up being on the field more and seeing more opportunity. Jones will need to be monitored in practice this upcoming week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Mason leads Vikings backfield in return Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Mason ran for 68 yards on 15 carries in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Mason did not start the game, but he was on the field more and saw more opportunity than Aaron Jones. He'll be an RB2 play next week against the Lions.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyler Murray does not turn ball over Sunday
items.desc: Kyler Murray completed 14-of-24 passes for 150 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Murray also added 39 yards on the ground. He didn't have many big plays, but most importantly he avoided any turnovers. He will remain a QB2 next week against the Lions.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colts D/ST keeps Vikings in check Sunday
items.desc: The Colts defense allowed 16 points on 275 total yards with three sacks against the Vikings.
items.impact: The Colts defense will be off the fantasy radar next week against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Spencer Shrader misses two field goals Sunday
items.desc: Spencer Shrader went 1-for-3 on field goal attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: Shrader missed field goals from 56 and 48 yards out. He has been more reliable on the season than he was this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Mallory does not haul in pass Sunday
items.desc: Will Mallory did not catch any of his three targets in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: Mallory saw the field more in the absence of Tyler Warren. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Downs sees team-high four targets Sunday
items.desc: Josh Downs caught 2-of-4 targets for 18 yards in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: Downs led the team in targets, while Keenan Allen led the team with just 31 receiving yards. Downs remains on the border of being a WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keenan Allen hauls in three passes Sunday
items.desc: Keenan Allen caught 3-of-3 targets for 31 yards in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: It was a low-volume passing day for the Colts offense as Allen led the team in receiving. He remains a low upside WR3/flex play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Seth McGowan sees 11 carries Sunday
items.desc: Seth McGowan ran for 46 yards on 11 carries in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings. He also caught his lone target for two yards receiving.
items.impact: McGowan saw a season-high in carries, his first time reaching double-digit carries. He is an intriguing stash for fantasy managers with Jonathan Taylor continuing to have his name brought up in trade rumors.
